resources.string: Messages hop phone to phone over Bluetooth. No signal, no SIM, no account.
The more people nearby, the further your message travels.
Direct messages are end-to-end encrypted. Nothing is stored on a server.
Allow Bluetooth for Nearsend Chat in Settings
Turn Bluetooth on to find people nearby
Open the app on another phone to connect
Open Nearby and tap someone to say hi.
Public · anyone in range can read this
Out of range · will send when nearby
Ask them to read the digits on their You tab. If they match, nobody is impersonating them.
Compare this in person to verify a contact. It changes if you erase everything.
Not security audited yet. Open source (GPL-3.0).
Erase all messages, keys and settings on this phone?
This cannot be undone. You will get a new identity.
Lets you receive messages while the app is closed. Shows a notification and uses some battery.
Let a friend scan this with Nearsend Chat. You both become verified.
Their phone confirms it too when it is in range.
Someone nearby with this name uses a different key and may be pretending to be them. Only the scanned code was verified.
The chat, nickname and verification are deleted from this phone.
Show this code to the person next to you, or scan theirs.
A code sent as text doesn\'t verify: the contact stays unverified until you scan each other\'s QR codes in person.
Add me on Nearsend Chat: copy this whole message, then in Chats tap Add or verify › Paste a code.
Not verified yet. Messages wait until they\'re in range. Scan each other\'s QR codes in person to verify.
No one is in range yet. Scan the code of the person next to you.
Nearsend Chat sends messages phone to phone over Bluetooth.
Up to 5 hops: other phones pass your message along until it arrives.
Your phone keeps the message and sends it when they\'re back in range (for up to 10 minutes).
Phones along the way pass it on but can\'t open it.
Scan each other\'s QR code. One scan verifies you both.
People nearby see this name. You can change it any time.
The alarm reaches phones nearby that have Nearsend Chat, also through other phones. It does not call emergency services.
Hold for 2 seconds to send an SOS alarm
SOS is on · sent again every 15 s
People who get the alarm see how far away you are and in which direction.
Calls and texts need cell signal. Texts are not encrypted.
Public · not encrypted. Every phone nearby can read it.
This phone forgets the group and ignores its new messages. The others are not told.
Add contacts first: scan a QR code or wait until someone is in range.
Public · not encrypted. Phones nearby keep it and show it to people who arrive later, until it expires.
Away · phones nearby carry your messages to them (up to 24 h)
Helps messages travel further and reach people who are away. Uses some battery.
Let senders see when their message reached you.
Notifications show who wrote, not what.
Messages to contacts who are out of Bluetooth range go through public relay servers on the internet. They stay end-to-end encrypted, but the servers can see your IP address and when you send.
Away · your messages go over the internet
No position yet. Try again outdoors.
Pure black background and no animations. Saves battery on OLED screens. Bluetooth still uses power.
Pick an emoji and a colour. People nearby see it next to your name.
Last 500 events: who connected, packet types, errors. No messages, photos or keys.
Their messages and announcements are hidden and ignored. You can unblock them in their contact info.
Only on this phone. The other person keeps their copy.
No favourites yet. Swipe left on a chat and tap More.
Show announcements from people nearby and notify me. Off: they are hidden, but your phone still passes them on.
Not sent. Tap the message to try again.
Delivered means every member\'s phone received it.
Delivered means their phone received it. Read receipts are not available yet.
Read appears when they open the chat, if both of you have Delivery receipts on.
Location Services is off on this iPhone. Turn it on in Settings › Privacy & Security › Location Services.
Location is blocked by Screen Time. Allow it in Settings › Screen Time › Content & Privacy Restrictions › Location Services.
Also dims the screen, and looks for phones less often while you are connected.
Nearsend Chat reaches phones about 10 to 50 metres away. People show up here when they come close.
Your friends need Nearsend Chat too
Open the app on both phones to connect faster
Not verified. Compare fingerprints in person to be sure this is really them.
Let a friend scan this to verify you. Do it in person.
This code doesn\'t belong to anyone nearby or in your chats. Be near them and try again.
Hold to record a voice message
Allow the microphone for Nearsend Chat in Settings to send voice messages.
Made small, about 20 KB, so it fits Bluetooth
Take a photo and send it
Your position as a map pin
For a voice message, hold the microphone button in the chat.

Open Control Center (swipe down from the top-right corner) and tap the Bluetooth icon so it turns blue. If Settings > Bluetooth shows Allow New Connections, tap it. iPhone does not let apps switch Bluetooth on.
People nearby see this name. No account, no phone number. You can change it any time on the You tab.
Location is off for Nearsend Chat
To attach your position to an SOS, allow location for Nearsend Chat in Settings. Until then the alarm is sent without it.
Location allowed · looking for your position…
Scan each other\'s codes, so you can both write. Messages reach them even far away, carried by phones in between.
A friend can send their code from Show my code › Share my code.
That is not a Nearsend contact code.
A friend scans this with Add contact to chat with you, even from far away. Scan theirs too, so you can both write.
Rings show signal strength, not direction.
iPhone does not let apps switch Bluetooth on. It takes two taps:
Swipe down from the top-right corner of the screen.
Tap the Bluetooth button so it turns blue.
Turn Bluetooth on. If you see Allow New Connections, tap it.
Privacy, strangers, app lock, battery, move to another phone
Black screen, no animations, dimmer screen, and Bluetooth looks for phones less often while you are connected.
People nearby see “%1$s” instead of your name and picture. People you already chat with still see your name.
Strangers are people you have no chat with yet. Their first message waits as a request: you choose to accept or block. They don\'t see that you read it.
Strangers are people you have no chat with yet. Their messages arrive like any other.
Strangers are people you have no chat with yet. Their messages are dropped. People you add by code or start a chat with can always write.
Notify me when a friend is nearby
When someone you chat with comes back in range after 30 minutes away. At most every 2 hours per person. Works while the app is open or running in the background.
The debug log has the last 500 events: who connected, packet types, errors. No messages, photos or keys. To report someone, long-press their message or open their contact info and tap Report.
App lock uses Face ID, Touch ID or your iPhone passcode. Turn on a passcode in Settings › Face ID & Passcode.
The file holds your identity, chats and contacts, locked with this password. Without it nobody can open the file, not even us. Nothing is uploaded: you choose where the file goes.
Send the file to the new phone
Send it with AirDrop or save it to Files. When the new phone works, erase this one: the same identity on two phones confuses delivery.
This replaces the identity, chats and settings on this phone with the ones in the file.
Done. This phone now has your identity and chats.
The identity, chats and settings here are replaced by the ones in the file.
Wrong password, or the file is damaged.
This is not a Nearsend transfer file.
This phone has no identity to move yet.
%1$s isn\'t in your chats yet. They don\'t know you\'ve seen this.
Say hi, or agree where to meet.
Bluetooth connects you to Nearsend phones nearby, with no Wi-Fi, no cell signal and no internet.
Battery saver is on: Nearsend looks for phones less often while you are connected. Messages may arrive a little later.
Low Power Mode is on: Nearsend looks for phones less often while you are connected. Messages may arrive a little later.
Low battery: Nearsend looks for phones less often while you are connected. Messages may arrive a little later.
In the background iPhone slows Bluetooth down, and nothing works after you swipe the app away. Leave it open in the background.
Recommend Nearsend Chat to the person next to you.
Nearsend Chat on the App Store
Show the code to the person next to you: their camera opens Nearsend Chat on the App Store.
They need internet once, to download it. After that it works with no signal.
Then add each other: tap My code on the You tab and scan.
QR code of the App Store page
Moves your identity, chats and contacts to a new iPhone with a password-protected file.
Deletes all messages, keys and settings on this phone. You get a new identity. This cannot be undone.
Nearsend Chat has no accounts and collects no data. The terms of use are Apple\'s standard licence agreement for App Store apps.

Bluetooth is off. Turn it on in Control Center to find people nearby.
It finds phones nearby and sends them your messages, with no internet. Your iPhone asks next: tap Allow.
Swipe down from the top-right corner to open Control Center, and tap Bluetooth so it turns blue. Apps can\'t turn it on for you.
Nearsend Chat needs Bluetooth to find people nearby. Turn it on in Settings › Nearsend Chat › Bluetooth.
Only when you share it in a chat or attach it to an SOS. It goes over Bluetooth to the people you choose, never to us. Your iPhone asks next.
To share your position, allow location in Settings › Nearsend Chat › Location.
Nearsend Chat needs Bluetooth to find people nearby. Tap Turn on Bluetooth, then Settings, and switch Bluetooth on. If you see Allow New Connections, tap it.
Attaching your position needs Location Services. Tap Turn on Location Services, then Settings, and switch it on.

To report someone, long-press their message or open their contact info and tap Report.
Shows sample people and chats, so you can try the app without another phone. Bluetooth is off while it is on; your own chats come back when you turn it off.
